candidates.description: This vector represents conjunctions and connective words across multiple languages, primarily focusing on variations of "and."
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters, specific subword tokens, and multilingual text fragments.
This feature activates on common Thai syllable and word endings alongside rare subword suffixes and proper noun fragments.
This vector detects common Thai script character sequences and subword prefixes.
This vector represents subword tokens and character fragments from the Thai script, frequently associated with the letter 'ส' (So Suea).
This feature vector is sensitive to the Thai vowel mark sara ee (ี) and its combinations with various consonant characters.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'อ' (O Ang) and its various combinations with vowel markers, tone marks, and subscript consonants.
This feature vector represents random character fragments and linguistic noise without a cohesive semantic concept.
This feature activates on common character n-grams and phonetic components found in Thai script and European names.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and terms related to Thai royalty or culture.
